en: Luxembourg, officially the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, as a landlocked country in Western Europe
Its borders with Belgium to the west and north, Germany to the east and France to the south
zh: 卢森堡正式称卢森堡大公国，是西欧内陆国家
西与北邻比利时，东接德国，南界法国

politics.zh: 卢森堡大公国是西欧内陆国家，西与北邻比利时，东接德国，南界法国，首都为卢森堡市。1815年成为大公国，1890年获得完全独立，两次世界大战中曾被德国占领；战后放弃中立并参与欧洲一体化，是欧洲联盟、北约与申根区的创始或核心成员，实行君主立宪与议会制。
politics.en: The Grand Duchy of Luxembourg is a landlocked country in Western Europe, bordered by Belgium to the west and north, Germany to the east and France to the south, with Luxembourg City as its capital. It became a grand duchy in 1815 and gained full independence in 1890, and it was occupied by Germany in both world wars; after 1945 it abandoned neutrality and joined European integration, becoming a founding or core member of the European Union, NATO and the Schengen area, and it is a constitutional monarchy with a parliamentary system.

economy.zh: 经济以金融服务业、钢铁工业与物流为基础，银行与投资基金集中，卢森堡市是重要的金融中心，钢铁与卫星通信等产业也有影响，跨境通勤劳动力占很大比重。
economy.en: The economy rests on financial services, the steel industry and logistics, with banks and investment funds concentrated in Luxembourg City, which is a major financial centre, and steel and satellite communications also significant, while cross-border commuters make up a large share of the workforce.

culture.zh: 卢森堡文化融合法语、德语与卢森堡语传统，三种语言在不同场合并用，卢森堡语为国家语言，天主教传统与地方节庆影响深远，中世纪城堡与老城区被列为世界遗产。
culture.en: Luxembourgish culture combines French, German and Luxembourgish traditions, the three languages being used in different settings with Luxembourgish as the national language, Catholic tradition and local festivals remain influential, and its medieval fortifications and old quarters are a World Heritage site.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1815年成为大公国、1890年获得完全独立、两次世界大战中的占领，以及战后参与欧洲一体化并加入欧元区与申根区。
events.en: Key moments are its creation as a grand duchy in 1815, full independence in 1890, the occupations of the two world wars and its post-war participation in European integration, including the euro and the Schengen area.

en: Morgannwg, now Glamorgan, as a kingdom in south-east Wales
Its use as a name for the Kingdom of Glywysing from the end of the tenth century until its end
zh: 摩根努格即今格拉摩根，是威尔士东南部的王国
10世纪末起成为格利维辛王国的名称，直至其终结

politics.zh: 摩根努格即今格拉摩根，是威尔士东南部的王国，10世纪末起成为格利维辛王国的名称，直至其终结。它由本地王统统治，以卡迪夫与兰达夫一带为中心，与德赫巴思、格温特及英格兰诸势力长期互动；11世纪末诺曼人入侵后逐步被征服，其地后来成为威尔士边区的一部分，名称演变为格拉摩根。
politics.en: Morgannwg, now Glamorgan, was a kingdom in south-east Wales, and from the end of the tenth century the name came into use for the Kingdom of Glywysing until that kingdom ended. Ruled by a local royal line and centred on the area of Cardiff and Llandaff, it interacted for generations with Deheubarth, Gwent and the English powers; after the Norman invasion at the end of the eleventh century it was gradually conquered, its lands becoming part of the Welsh marches and its name surviving as Glamorgan.

economy.zh: 经济以沿海平原的农业、畜牧与布里斯托尔海峡沿岸的贸易为基础，修道院与地方市集是交换中心，沿海低地与谷地适合耕作，牲畜与羊毛是主要交换物。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming and herding on the coastal plain and on trade along the Bristol Channel, with monasteries and local markets as centres of exchange, the lowland and valleys suited to cultivation, and livestock and wool the main goods traded.

culture.zh: 摩根努格保留威尔士的圣徒崇拜与修道传统，兰达夫的教堂与主教区是宗教中心，威尔士语与地方谱系延续，石十字与教堂建筑留下遗存。
culture.en: Morgannwg preserved Welsh saint cults and monastic tradition, the church and bishopric of Llandaff being a religious centre, Welsh speech and local genealogies continuing, and carved crosses and church buildings surviving as remains. Its religious houses were later rebuilt in stone by the Normans.

events.zh: 关键节点包括10世纪末名称的使用、11世纪与邻近威尔士王国的互动、11世纪末诺曼人入侵，以及此后并入威尔士边区并改称格拉摩根。
events.en: Key moments are the adoption of the name at the end of the tenth century, its dealings with neighbouring Welsh kingdoms in the eleventh, the Norman invasion at the end of that century and its incorporation into the Welsh marches under the name Glamorgan.

value.zh: 10世纪末起成为格利维辛王国的名称。
value.en: From the end of the tenth century it was the name of the Kingdom of Glywysing.

en: The Principality of Achaea, or Principality of Morea, as one of the vassal states of the Latin Empire after the capture of Constantinople
Its rule over the Peloponnese by Frankish lords and its later dependence on Naples
zh: 亚该亚侯国又称摩里亚侯国，是君士坦丁堡被攻陷后拉丁帝国的附庸国之一
由法兰克领主统治伯罗奔尼撒，后依附那不勒斯

politics.zh: 亚该亚侯国又称摩里亚侯国，是1204年君士坦丁堡被攻陷后拉丁帝国的附庸国之一，由法兰克领主统治伯罗奔尼撒半岛，以安兹拉维达与米斯特拉一带为中心。它实行西欧式封建制度，设十二个男爵领地，与威尼斯的殖民地及拜占庭的伊庇鲁斯、尼西亚政权长期冲突；14世纪后逐步被拜占庭与后来的奥斯曼势力取代。
politics.en: The Principality of Achaea, also known as the Principality of Morea, was one of the vassal states of the Latin Empire created after the capture of Constantinople in 1204, ruled by Frankish lords over the Peloponnese from centres such as Andravida and Mistra. It introduced western European feudal arrangements with twelve baronies and fought for decades with the Venetian colonies and with the Byzantine states of Epirus and Nicaea; from the fourteenth century it was gradually displaced by Byzantine and later Ottoman power.

economy.zh: 经济以伯罗奔尼撒的农业、丝绸与葡萄酒生产以及沿海港口贸易为基础，科林斯与帕特雷等港口连接意大利与黎凡特，封建庄园与农奴劳动构成农业生产的基础。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the Peloponnese, silk and wine production and trade through the coastal ports, with Corinth and Patras linking Italy and the Levant, and feudal estates worked by dependent peasants forming the basis of agriculture.

culture.zh: 侯国在希腊土地上移植了西欧的封建与教会制度，哥特式教堂与城堡与拜占庭建筑并存，法语与希腊语并用，编年史《摩里亚的征服》记录其早期历史。
culture.en: The principality transplanted western European feudal and ecclesiastical institutions onto Greek soil, Gothic churches and castles standing alongside Byzantine buildings, French and Greek both in use, and the chronicle of the conquest of the Morea recording its early history.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1204年建国、13世纪的封建扩张、1260年代拜占庭收复部分领土，以及14世纪后逐步被拜占庭与奥斯曼势力取代。
events.en: Key moments are its creation in 1204, its feudal expansion in the thirteenth century, the Byzantine recovery of parts of its territory in the 1260s and its gradual displacement by Byzantine and Ottoman power from the fourteenth century.

value.en: It was created after the fall of Constantinople in 1204.

en: The French Empire, known retroactively as the First French Empire and colloquially as Napoleonic France, as the empire ruled by Napoleon Bonaparte
Its domination of much of continental Europe in the early nineteenth century
zh: 法兰西第一帝国是拿破仑·波拿巴统治的帝国，后世称第一帝国，俗称拿破仑法国
19世纪初一度控制欧洲大陆大部

politics.zh: 法兰西第一帝国是拿破仑·波拿巴统治的帝国，后世称第一帝国，俗称拿破仑法国，1804年由执政府改为帝国，1814年拿破仑退位后终结。它通过军事征服与附庸国体系控制欧洲大陆大部，颁布《拿破仑法典》并重组行政、教育与财政制度；1812年远征俄国失败后势力衰退，1815年百日王朝后彻底终结。
politics.en: The French Empire, known retroactively as the First French Empire and colloquially as Napoleonic France, was the empire ruled by Napoleon Bonaparte, proclaimed in 1804 in place of the consulate and ended by his abdication in 1814. Through military conquest and a system of client states it dominated much of continental Europe, issuing the Napoleonic Code and reorganising administration, education and finance; after the disastrous Russian campaign of 1812 its power declined, and the Hundred Days of 1815 ended it for good.

economy.zh: 经济以农业与制造业为基础，大陆封锁体系试图切断英国贸易，国家推行关税保护、修路与银行改革，法兰西银行与新的税收制度支撑战争开支。
economy.en: The economy rested on agriculture and manufacturing, with the Continental System attempting to cut off British trade, the state promoting protective tariffs, road building and banking reform, and the Bank of France and a new tax system supporting the costs of war.

culture.zh: 帝国时期新古典主义风格在建筑与艺术中盛行，凯旋门与协和广场等工程动工，法典与中学、大学制度影响深远，绘画与肖像艺术服务于皇权形象。
culture.en: Neoclassical style dominated architecture and the arts in the imperial period, with works such as the Arc de Triomphe and the Place de la Concorde begun, the legal codes and the secondary and higher education systems widely influential, and painting and portraiture serving the image of imperial power.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1804年称帝、1805至1807年的一系列胜利、1812年远征俄国、1814年退位，以及1815年滑铁卢战役后的终结。
events.en: Key moments are his proclamation as emperor in 1804, the victories from 1805 to 1807, the Russian campaign of 1812, the abdication of 1814 and the final defeat at Waterloo in 1815. Its legal and administrative reforms long outlived the empire itself.

value.en: It was proclaimed in 1804 in place of the consulate.

value.zh: 颁布《拿破仑法典》并重组行政与教育制度。
value.en: It issued the Napoleonic Code and reorganised administration and education.

en: East Francia, or the Kingdom of the East Franks, as a successor state of the Carolingian Empire ruled by the Carolingians
Its position as the predecessor of the medieval German kingdom
zh: 东法兰克王国是加洛林帝国的继承国之一，由加洛林家族统治
是中世纪德意志王国的前身

politics.zh: 东法兰克王国是加洛林帝国的继承国之一，由加洛林家族统治，843年《凡尔登条约》后取得莱茵河以东的广大地区，包括萨克森、巴伐利亚、施瓦本与法兰克尼亚等地。国王依靠公爵与主教治理，选举与世袭因素并存；911年加洛林王统断绝后由本地公爵推举国王，东法兰克逐渐演变为德意志王国，奥托一世于962年加冕为皇帝。
politics.en: East Francia, or the Kingdom of the East Franks, was a successor state of the Carolingian Empire ruled by the Carolingians, taking in the lands east of the Rhine after the treaty of Verdun in 843, including Saxony, Bavaria, Swabia and Franconia. Its kings governed through dukes and bishops, with both election and inheritance playing a part; when the Carolingian line ended in 911 the local dukes chose a king, and East Francia gradually became the German kingdom, Otto I being crowned emperor in 962.

economy.zh: 经济以莱茵河与多瑙河流域的农业、庄园制度与河运贸易为基础，修道院与王室庄园是生产与管理的中心，东部边疆的垦殖与斯拉夫地区的贸易逐步扩展。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the Rhine and Danube basins, the manorial system and river trade, with monasteries and royal estates serving as centres of production and administration, and colonisation along the eastern frontier and trade with Slavic lands gradually expanding.

culture.zh: 东法兰克是拉丁教会与加洛林文艺复兴传统延续的地区，修道院学校与抄本工坊发达，古高地德语文献开始出现，教会与王权共同推动文化与行政的统一。
culture.en: East Francia continued the Latin church and Carolingian Renaissance traditions, its monastic schools and scriptoria were productive, Old High German texts began to appear, and church and crown together advanced cultural and administrative unity. Its royal chancery produced documents that shaped later German practice.

events.zh: 关键节点包括843年《凡尔登条约》、9世纪的加洛林统治、911年加洛林王统断绝与公爵推举国王，以及962年奥托一世加冕为皇帝。
events.en: Key moments are the treaty of Verdun in 843, Carolingian rule in the ninth century, the end of the Carolingian line and the ducal election of a king in 911 and the imperial coronation of Otto I in 962.

value.zh: 843年《凡尔登条约》后取得莱茵河以东地区。
value.en: It took the lands east of the Rhine after the treaty of Verdun in 843.

value.zh: 逐渐演变为德意志王国。
value.en: It gradually became the German kingdom.

en: The Electorate of Hanover as an electorate of the Holy Roman Empire in north-western Germany
Its rise from the principality of Calenberg and its union with the British crown from 1714
zh: 汉诺威选侯国是神圣罗马帝国位于德国西北部的选侯国
由卡伦贝格亲王国发展而来，1714年起与英国王位联合

politics.zh: 汉诺威选侯国是神圣罗马帝国位于德国西北部的选侯国，由卡伦贝格亲王国发展而来，1692年获得选侯地位，1714年其君主乔治一世继承英国王位，形成共主联合。它由汉诺威家族统治，设有宫廷与地方等级议会，1803年被法国占领，1814年后成为汉诺威王国，与英国的联系延续至1837年。
politics.en: The Electorate of Hanover was an electorate of the Holy Roman Empire in north-western Germany that arose from the principality of Calenberg, gaining electoral status in 1692, and in 1714 its ruler George I inherited the British throne, creating a personal union. Ruled by the House of Hanover with a court and local estates, it was occupied by France in 1803, became the Kingdom of Hanover after 1814, and its link with Britain lasted until 1837.

economy.zh: 经济以北德平原的农业、畜牧业与港口贸易为基础，易北河与威悉河的航运连接北海与内陆，汉诺威城是行政与商业中心，纺织与矿业在部分地区发展。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming and herding on the north German plain and on trade through its ports, with shipping on the Elbe and Weser linking the North Sea with the interior, Hanover as the administrative and commercial centre, and textiles and mining developing in some districts.

culture.zh: 选侯国以信义宗传统为基础，哥廷根大学是重要的学术中心，宫廷赞助音乐与建筑，巴洛克与古典主义建筑留下遗存，德语文学与科学研究在此发展。
culture.en: The electorate rested on Lutheran tradition, the University of Gottingen was an important scholarly centre, its court patronised music and architecture, Baroque and classical buildings survive as remains, and German literature and scientific research developed there.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1692年获得选侯地位、1714年与英国王位联合、1803年被法国占领，以及1814年后成为汉诺威王国。
events.en: Key moments are the grant of electoral status in 1692, the personal union with the British crown in 1714, the French occupation of 1803 and its transformation into the Kingdom of Hanover after 1814. Its university and court made it a centre of the German Enlightenment.

value.en: Its ruler inherited the British throne in 1714.

en: Sicily under Islamic rule from the late ninth to the late eleventh centuries
Its prosperity and influence as a centre of Mediterranean trade and learning
zh: 西西里埃米尔国是9世纪末至11世纪末伊斯兰统治下的西西里
作为地中海贸易与学术中心而繁荣一时

politics.zh: 西西里埃米尔国是9世纪末至11世纪末伊斯兰统治下的西西里，由阿格拉布王朝开始征服、后由法蒂玛与卡尔比王朝统治，以巴勒莫为中心。它控制地中海中部的航路与贸易，与北非、埃及及意大利诸城邦互动；11世纪中叶后因内部纷争与意大利南部诺曼人的进攻而瓦解，1091年诺曼人完成征服。
politics.en: Sicily was under Islamic rule from the late ninth to the late eleventh centuries, the conquest begun under the Aghlabids and continued by the Fatimids and then the Kalbids, with Palermo as its centre. It controlled the sea routes and trade of the central Mediterranean and interacted with North Africa, Egypt and the Italian city-states; after the mid-eleventh century internal conflict and the advance of the Normans from southern Italy broke it up, and the Norman conquest was completed in 1091.

economy.zh: 经济以巴勒莫与巴勒莫湾的港口贸易、灌溉农业与手工业为基础，柑橘、甘蔗、棉花与纸草等作物引入，纺织品与陶器出口地中海各地，关税与市场税是主要收入。
economy.en: The economy rested on trade through Palermo and its bay, irrigated farming and crafts, with citrus, sugar cane, cotton and papyrus introduced, textiles and pottery exported across the Mediterranean, and customs and market dues the main sources of income.

culture.zh: 西西里是阿拉伯、希腊与拉丁文化交汇之地，阿拉伯语与希腊语并用，清真寺与宫殿建筑留下遗存，农学、地理与诗歌在此发展，双语文书与翻译传统影响深远。
culture.en: Sicily was a meeting place of Arab, Greek and Latin cultures, Arabic and Greek were both used, mosques and palaces survive as remains, agronomy, geography and poetry developed there, and bilingual documents and translation traditions were widely influential.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9世纪中叶开始征服、10世纪卡尔比王朝的统治、11世纪中叶的内部纷争，以及1091年诺曼人完成征服。
events.en: Key moments are the beginning of the conquest in the mid-ninth century, Kalbid rule in the tenth, internal conflict in the mid-eleventh and the completion of the Norman conquest in 1091. Its administrative and agricultural legacy remained visible for centuries.

value.en: The Norman conquest was completed in 1091.

en: The Duchy of Opole as one of the duchies of Silesia ruled by a branch of the Polish Piast dynasty
Its position in Upper Silesia around the town of Opole
zh: 奥波莱公国是西里西亚诸公国之一，由波兰皮雅斯特王朝的分支统治
位于上西里西亚，以奥波莱城为中心

politics.zh: 奥波莱公国是西里西亚诸公国之一，由波兰皮雅斯特王朝的分支统治，位于上西里西亚，以奥波莱城为中心，12世纪末自西里西亚公国分裂而来。公国在德意志移民与波兰、捷克、德意志三种文化交汇的环境中发展，14世纪起承认波希米亚王权，16世纪后随哈布斯堡继承而转入其统治，公统于17世纪后期断绝。
politics.en: The Duchy of Opole was one of the duchies of Silesia ruled by a branch of the Polish Piast dynasty, lying in Upper Silesia around the town of Opole and emerging from the division of the Duchy of Silesia at the end of the twelfth century. It developed where German settlement met Polish, Czech and German cultural influences, acknowledged Bohemian overlordship from the fourteenth century and passed under Habsburg rule with the Bohemian inheritance, its ducal line dying out in the later seventeenth century.

economy.zh: 经济以奥得河上游的农业、矿业与市镇贸易为基础，奥波莱是区域市场与手工业中心，13世纪起德意志移民带来新的耕作与城镇制度，铁与铅的开采提供收入。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the upper Oder region, mining and the trade of its towns, with Opole a regional market and centre of crafts, German settlers bringing new farming and town institutions from the thirteenth century, and iron and lead mining supplying revenue.

culture.zh: 奥波莱公国处于波兰、德意志与捷克文化交汇处，城镇依马格德堡法建立，教堂与市政厅建筑兼有多种风格，拉丁、德文与波兰语文书并存，皮雅斯特家族的赞助留下建筑遗产。
culture.en: The Duchy of Opole lay where Polish, German and Czech cultures met, its towns were founded under Magdeburg law, its churches and town halls combine several styles, Latin, German and Polish documents existed side by side, and the patronage of the Piast family left an architectural heritage.

events.zh: 关键节点包括12世纪末公国分裂形成、13世纪德意志移民与城镇建设、14世纪承认波希米亚王权，以及16世纪后随哈布斯堡继承转入其统治。
events.en: Key moments are the division that formed the duchy at the end of the twelfth century, German settlement and town building in the thirteenth, the acknowledgement of Bohemian overlordship in the fourteenth and its passage under Habsburg rule with the Bohemian inheritance in the sixteenth.

value.zh: 12世纪末自西里西亚公国分裂而来。
value.en: It emerged from the division of the Duchy of Silesia at the end of the twelfth century.
It acknowledged Bohemian overlordship from the fourteenth century.
